PG1.quote: `cannot load such file -- pagy/extras/items (LoadError)` ... pages show 20 notes instead of 10 ... the `per_page` URL parameter is ignored ... the cap rises from 50 to 100 ... `undefined method 'items' for an instance of Pagy` ... Repair: use `Pagy::DEFAULT[:limit] = 10`, `[:limit_param] = :per_page` and `[:limit_max] = 50` ... change `@pagy.items` to `@pagy.limit` ... F1, F2 and F3 don't work on 8.6.3, so they must ship together with the version bump.
PG1.reasons: Validation: the 25-note probe checks page 2 at size 5, page 99, retained per_page links and the selected option. It does not use filter-excluded or foreign notes, does not follow the actual Next href, and does not check that a request for 500 is capped at 50, that filter queries are kept exactly, /journal, empty search, the foreign-note 404 or the anonymous redirect.

PG2.quote: In 9.x, a page of `""`, `0`, `-1` or `two` reaches Pagy as 0 and raises `Pagy::VariableError` ... `@pagy, @notes = pagy(@notes, page: [params[:page].to_i, 1].max)` ... On a copy still running 8.6.3, the probe and the full suite both passed.
PG2.reasons: Validation: the plan checks the fix on 8.6.3 and includes page-2 and page-99 controls, but it never says the probe compares all four invalid inputs with page-one content, and it has no filtering or ownership controls.
